components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with Signal Terracotta fill and tactile micro-elevation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #D9541E; color: #F3EEE3; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #B83D0E; transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(217, 84, 30, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D9541E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary outline button for passive actions and navigation controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #F3EEE3; color: #111111; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #E8E2D5; border-color: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px 1px rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.16); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D9541E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Container Card
components.description: Flat architectural card container with hairline border boundary.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background-color: #F3EEE3; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #111111; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.65); margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; align-items: baseline; } .ds-metric { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input field with subtle border and focused terracotta ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; background-color: transparent; color: #111111; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.45); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #D9541E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(217, 84, 30, 0.25); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill badge indicating delivery state or event type.
components.css: .ds-badge-delivered { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; background-color: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12); color: #2D6A4F; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.25); margin-right: 6px; } .ds-badge-failed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; background-color: rgba(217, 84, 30, 0.12); color: #D9541E; border: 1px solid rgba(217, 84, 30, 0.25); }

components.description: Inline identifier pill for webhook IDs, topics, and signatures.

narrative.overview:
TrueHook's visual identity embodies the focused precision of a wire-tight telegraph station: utilitarian, high-contrast, and stripped of all decorative pretense. Built specifically for engineers monitoring event pipelines and delivery attempts, the interface prioritizes high-fidelity observability and immediate diagnostic clarity over decorative embellishments.

The foundational canvas is built upon high-contrast dual tones: Raw Cream (#F3EEE3) and Obsidian Black (#111111), punctuated with an intentional strike of Signal Terracotta (#D9541E). Every screen feels grounded and architectural—resting surfaces remain flat and structured with crisp 1px borders, while micro-interactions provide tactile, responsive feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Extreme Contrast & Focus: Unapologetic dual-tone canvas dominating 90% of surfaces.
Signal-to-Noise Purity: Total rejection of candy-colored status indicators and decorative gradients.
Architectural Flatness: Structural 1px boundaries over fuzzy elevation.
Engineer-Centric Typography: Seamless pairing of modern sans-serif with prominent monospace typography.

rules.name: The 90/10 Ratio Rule
rules.body: Raw Cream (#F3EEE3) and Obsidian Black (#111111) must account for at least 90% of any view. Signal Terracotta (#D9541E) is limited to 10% maximum surface coverage; its restraint is what preserves its urgent signal power.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Direct Tailwind color scales (gray-*, slate-*, blue-*, red-*) and arbitrary raw hex classes are strictly prohibited. All styling must consume semantic tokens from globals.css.

rules.name: The Code-Type Rule
rules.body: Any value representing an identifier, UUID, webhook URL, HTTP status code, secret preview, timestamp, or JSON payload MUST render in Geist Mono (font-mono).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest entirely flat without ambient drop shadows. Depth is communicated via 1px border strokes (border-border) and tonal surface contrast. Shadows exist purely as interactive feedback.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-canvas, text-foreground, border-border, bg-primary, ring-ring) exclusively.
Do preserve the 90/10 ratio between neutral surfaces and Signal Terracotta accents.
Do render all IDs, endpoints, cryptographic signatures, HTTP status codes, and payloads in Geist Mono.
Do use clean 1px hairline borders (border-border) to delineate containers and tables.
Do provide tactile micro-interactions on buttons (hover:-translate-y-0.5, active:scale-[0.98]).
Do keep customer /signin and /signup routes in Obsidian dark mode while keeping workspace apps in clean light cream mode.
donts: Don't use default Tailwind color scales (text-gray-500, bg-blue-600, text-red-500).
Don't apply fuzzy ambient drop shadows or heavy blur cards to resting interface components.
Don't introduce multi-colored gradient backgrounds or decorative floating blobs.
Don't clutter views with non-standard status colors; failure, errors, and primary alerts remain anchored in Signal Terracotta.
Don't compromise keyboard focus states; every interactive control must visibly project ring-ring.
